messages.author: b7dcd2d20667e606
messages.subject: Missing weekend data in Part 5
parts:
Hi all,

I am using GGIR package to extract my 24 h physical activity data. I have one participant in Part 2_daysummary output, he completed 6 days, (5 weekdays 1 weekend), this was shown in Part 2 day summary and part 2 summary. The measurement of the device was set at 100 Hz and recorded for 24 hours without fail. We distributed the accelerometer on Saturday and set the device to begin recording at midnight, 00:00 (Sunday). However, on the first day (Sunday), he did not acquire enough hours to be included (12 hours only). He is still included in the analysis because he met our criteria (at least 3 weekdays, and 1 weekend day).

However, as I wish to access his Part 5_daysummary (MM), only weekday data appeared and no weekend data was available, although it was successfully recorded in Part 2 daysummary for MVPA. Is there something wrong with the coding I use? Below is my coding:

library (GGIR)
g.shell.GGIR(mode =c(1,2,3,4,5),
datadir ="",
outputdir ="",
windowsizes =c(1,900,3600),
do.enmo =FALSE,
do.enmoa =TRUE,
acc.metric="ENMOa",
desiredtz =("Europe/London"),
strategy =1,
hrs.del.start =0,
hrs.del.end =0,
maxdur =7,
includedaycrit =16,
qwindow =c(0,24),
winhr =c(5,7,10),
idloc =1,
ilevel =c(0, 40, 80, 120, 8000),
threshold.lig =c(6/80) * 1000,
threshold.mod =c(20/80) * 1000,
threshold.vig =c(61/80) * 1000,
mvpathreshold =c(20/80) * 1000,
do.anglez =TRUE,
do.report =c(2,3,4,5),
do.visual =TRUE,
visualreport =TRUE,
overwrite =TRUE)

Your input is very much appreciated.

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Missing weekend data in Part 5
parts:
Hi,

Can you check if that day appears in the full part 5 report? You'll find that in the QC folder, within the results folder in your output directory. You should get all days in that report, and there you'll probably see the reason why this day is not included in the day report (either the total duration of the day is lower than 23 hours, or the nonwear time during the awake time is higher than 33%).

Best,
Jairo

You should get all days in that report, and there you'll probably see the reason why this day is not included in the day report (either the total duration of the day is lower than 23 hours, or the nonwear time during the awake time is higher than 33%).
